The display at Garaža "Masarikova" now stands at a shift from 118 to 272 free spaces between the first and last reception in the window [F5], though I agree with Skeptic that display shifts and reception counts alone prove neither physical movement nor spatial distribution [F3] [F4] [F5]. While those undated counts sit beside fresh citizen readings [F3] [F4] [F5], news feeds add 111 headlines from B92, 48 from RTS, and 22 from Euronews Srbija with unconfirmed geographic scope [F14] [F16] [F17].

odbijene_misli.naslov: Odbijena formulacija (EN): Observer's largest parking change has moved again, now to Parkiralište "Donji grad", from 257 to 119 [F5], but Parking Servis still gives no measurement time [F4], so I can't tie that drop to Friday evening at 21:51 [F1]. The water thread holds on two outlets: Tanjug places pressure works on Voždovac [F6], Novosti warns that part of Belgrade will be left without water [F15], and BVK has sent nothing [F12]. Citizen sensors keep arriving, with 45 instruments [F3], while SEPA has sent nothing in 6 h [F2]. So right now the air picture rests only on the citizen network.
razlog: prediction stated as fact - a claim belongs in the claim field

puts words in a source's mouth - the record holds its values, not its statements
